author: Crimson_Aught
body:
Avicus Wiki




What is it

Welcome to Avicus Wiki. There you can find list of our maps and their images and descriptions, minigames and tournaments descriptions and other interesting information. And a lot will come.

Minigames Maps Tournaments


Contribute

You always may to help with editing and expanding the wiki. You can add new pages, videos and images, edit them and correct the mistakes. You are welcome to ask me for help and advices or suggest something here below.
